app.title: Loan management
app.description: Loans, repayments, collateral and accounts for staff.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved. Nothing has been changed.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The page could not be shown. Nothing has been saved. Try again, and if it happens again tell your manager the time it happened.
error.inAppTitle: This page could not be shown

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: For staff only. Accounts are created by the administrator.

errors.invalidInput: Enter your email address and password.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not correct.
errors.inactive: This account is not active. Ask the administrator to check it.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again in a minute.

notices.inactive: This account is not active. Ask the administrator to check it.
notices.expired: For security, sessions end after 12 hours. Sign in again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.forbidden: You do not have access to that page. You have been brought back to the dashboard.
dashboard.comingUp: Your work summary appears here as each part of the system is switched on: due loans, collections, approvals and cash.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pendingHint: Leave empty until MSI confirms it. Empty fields print blank on documents.

validation.amount: Enter an amount in dollars, for example 2,000.00.
validation.code: Use 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter, for example BR4.
validation.branchRequired: Cashiers and loan officers need a branch.

company.heading: Company header
company.intro: Shown on every screen, receipt and document.
company.name: Company name
company.logoIntro: Always shown on a white tile. PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
company.templatesIntro: Placeholders in braces are filled in for each loan: {placeholders}.
company.reminder: Reminder before or on the due date

branches.heading: Branches
branches.intro: The branch code appears in loan, receipt and expense numbers and cannot change later.
branches.name: Name
branches.empty: No branches yet. Add the first branch to start.

rules.heading: Rule settings
rules.intro: Defaults from the assumption register. Each value is waiting for MSI sign-off (see docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md).
rules.loanManagerLimit: Largest loan a manager may approve (A-07)
rules.loanManagerLimitHelp: Above this amount the CEO must approve.
rules.expenseLimit: Expenses recorded without manager approval, up to (A-20)
rules.collateralRequired: Collateral is required for every loan (A-10)
rules.multiLoan: One collateral item may secure more than one active loan (A-10)
rules.requireRemittance: Field collections must be handed over to a cashier (A-12)
rules.checkFunds: Check the cash balance before paying out a loan
rules.allocationIntro: Each payment pays these parts in this order.
rules.goLiveHelp: Before this date the accountant and admin may enter back-dated records. Leave empty until it is agreed.
rules.clockIntro: Moves the system date for demonstrations. Production always uses the real date.
rules.clockFrozen: Keep the clock stopped at this time

users.heading: Users
users.intro: Only the administrator creates accounts. Staff cannot sign themselves up.
users.name: Full name
users.resetConfirm: Reset the password for {name}? Their current password stops working at once.
users.passwordIntro: Give this password to {name} in person. It is shown only once and is not stored anywhere you can see it again.
users.selfNote: You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself.

products.heading: Loan products
products.intro: Interest, term and penalty rules offered to borrowers. A loan copies its product's rules when it is submitted, so changes here apply only to new loans.
products.name: Product
products.snapshotNote: Interest is flat: principal × rate × months, charged at payout. Existing loans keep the rules they were approved with.

validation.percent: Enter a percentage with at most two decimals (for example 20 or 12.5).
validation.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number in the allowed range.
validation.termOrder: The usual term cannot be longer than the longest term.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every change in the system, newest first. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.intro: Every money movement is a balanced journal. Posted journals cannot be changed; mistakes are corrected with a reversing journal.
ledger.empty: No journals match these filters. Journals appear here as loans are paid out, payments come in and expenses are paid.

trial.heading: Trial balance as at {date}
trial.balanced: Balanced: total debits equal total credits.
trial.unbalanced: Not balanced: total debits and credits differ by {difference}. Tell the accountant and Corex support straight away.
trial.empty: No entries up to this date.

manual.heading: Request a manual journal
manual.intro: For corrections and entries that no other screen records. A manager approves it before it is posted. Every manual journal needs a memo explaining why.
manual.sent: Sent for approval. A manager will review it.
manual.lineError: Enter an amount in either the debit or the credit column, not both.
manual.minLines: A journal needs at least two lines.
manual.mineEmpty: You have not requested any manual journals or capital entries yet.

capital.heading: Record owner capital
capital.intro: Money the owners put into the business (recipe R10: the account is debited, Owner's Capital is credited). A manager approves it before it is posted.

customers.title: Customers
customers.count: {count, plural, =0 {No customers} one {# customer} other {# customers}}
customers.empty: No customers yet. Loan officers and managers add them here.

filters.label: Find customers
filters.qPlaceholder: Name, phone, ID number or code

validation.phone: Enter a phone number with 7 to 15 digits.

form.title: New customer
form.label: New customer
form.intro: Enter the details from the customer's ID. Once saved, any change to this record needs a manager's approval.
form.documentsIntro: Optional now; you can add documents later. Large photos are made smaller before they are sent.
form.fileHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP, or PDF for scans. Up to 10 MB.
form.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.

duplicate.heading: This customer may already be registered
duplicate.managerHelp: Check the existing record first. If this really is a different person, give the reason and create the record anyway.
duplicate.officerHelp: Check the existing record. If this really is a different person, ask a manager to create the record.
duplicate.reason: Reason for creating a second record

form.photoIntro: Optional. The new photo replaces the current one once a manager approves.
form.editReason: Reason (optional; required to keep a phone or ID number another customer has)

profile.title: Customer
profile.requested: Your change was sent for approval. The current details stay in use until a manager approves.

pending.heading: 1 change waiting for approval.
pending.body: {summary}, requested by {requester} {when}. The current details stay in use until a manager approves.

documentsForm.label: Add a document
documentsForm.help: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB.

profile.statusIntro: A status change needs a manager's approval and a reason.

when.minutes: {count, plural, one {# minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}
when.hours: {count, plural, one {# hour ago} other {# hours ago}}

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.waitingForYou: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waiting for you} other {# waiting for you}}
approvals.mineIntro: Requests you made and what was decided.

empty.waiting: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
empty.mine: You have not made any requests yet.

approvals.newPhoto: A new photo is attached to this request.
approvals.duplicateOverride: Another customer has this phone or ID number; the manager who asked gave a reason to keep it.
approvals.footer: You cannot approve requests you made yourself. Every decision is recorded with your name and the time.
approvals.aboveLimit: Above the {limit} manager limit, so it needs CEO approval.
approvals.voidNote: Approving posts a reversing journal dated today. The receipt is marked VOID; nothing is deleted.

guarantors.heading: Guarantors (optional)
guarantors.intro: Up to 3 people who promise to pay if the borrower cannot. Their ID scan is added with the loan documents.

validation.phone: Enter a phone number with 7 to 15 digits.

validation.amount: Enter an amount in dollars, for example 1000 or 1,000.00.

wizard.title: New loan
wizard.intro: Five short steps. Nothing is saved until you send the application; a manager (or the CEO above the limit) approves it before the cashier pays out.
wizard.noProducts: No loan product is offered. Ask the administrator to add one under Settings, Loan products.
wizard.searchHelp: Type at least 2 letters or digits of the name, phone, ID number or code.
wizard.noMatches: No active customer matches. Register the customer first.

preview.empty: Enter the amount to see the interest, total and due date.
preview.due: Due date if paid out today
preview.explain: Flat interest at {rate} per month, charged when the loan is paid out.
preview.penalty: If unpaid, the first penalty of {amount} is charged on {date}.
preview.manager: A manager approves loans up to {limit}.
preview.ceo: Above {limit}: the CEO approves this loan.

wizard.collateralIntro: Collateral is optional for this product setting. Pick the borrower's items or add a new one.
wizard.collateralIntroRequired: Every loan needs collateral (A-10). Pick the borrower's items or add a new one.
wizard.noCollateral: The borrower has no free items registered yet.
wizard.collateralNeeded: Add at least one collateral item.
wizard.guarantorDocHelp: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB.

loans.windowed: {count, plural, =0 {No loans} one {# loan} other {# loans}}, open or issued or closed since {date}.

detail.waitingCeo: Waiting for the CEO's approval (sent by {name} on {date}); the amount is above the manager limit.
detail.approvedNotice: Approved. A cashier pays it out from this page.

activity.empty: Nothing has been posted for this loan yet.
activity.interest: Interest charged ({rate} × {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}})
activity.note: Balances are calculated from the ledger. No entry can be edited; mistakes are reversed with approval.

actions.cancelConfirm: Cancel {loan}? It cannot be paid out afterwards.

documents.heading: Documents
documents.later: The loan agreement can be printed once the loan is approved.

agreement.title: Loan agreement
agreement.rate: {rate} flat × {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
agreement.dueAtPayout: {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} after the payout date
agreement.verify: Check that this document is genuine by scanning the code or visiting:

payments.title: Payments
payments.windowed: {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}} since {date}.

receive.title: Receive payment
receive.hits: {count, plural, =0 {No open loans found} one {# open loan found} other {# open loans found}}
receive.noHits: No open loan matches. Only paid-out loans that still owe money can take a payment.
receive.start: Search for the customer or the loan number to begin.
receive.notOpen: This loan is not open for payments. Only paid-out loans that still owe money can take a payment.
receive.daysOverdue: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
receive.referenceHelpMomo: The mobile money transaction ID, for example OM-7731904.
receive.referenceHelpBank: The bank slip or transfer reference.
receive.overpayment: This is more than the {amount} owed. Enter {amount} or less.
receive.previewUnavailable: The preview could not be updated. The amount is checked again when you save.
receive.fieldHandover: The borrower gets a receipt now. The cash shows as "with you" until the cashier confirms the handover.

validation.amount: Enter an amount more than zero, with at most 2 decimals.
validation.method: Choose how the money was paid.
validation.reference: Enter the transaction reference (at least 4 characters).
validation.referenceLong: The reference can have at most 100 characters.

void.confirm: Void {receipt}? Another manager or the CEO must approve it; the payment is then reversed.
void.sent: Void requested. Nothing changes until it is approved.

receipts.voidNote: This payment was voided and reversed. This receipt is no longer valid.

field.empty: Nothing due today. Loans you look after appear here on their due date.
field.cashNone: No field cash waiting for handover.
field.cashNote: {count, plural, one {# collection} other {# collections}} since {date}. Hand over to the cashier.
field.notOpen: This loan is not open for payments.
field.otherBranch: This loan belongs to another branch. Field payments are taken for loans of your own branch.

remittance.title: Field cash
remittance.intro: Collections officers made in the field, waiting for the cash to be handed over. Tick what you received, count it and enter the total.
remittance.empty: No field cash is waiting for handover.
remittance.selected: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {# collection selected} other {# collections selected}}
remittance.done: Handover of {amount} confirmed. The cash is now in the branch cash account.
